LoKey Randomness
TRNG · Fortuna · VirtIO entropy health. NIST-style monobit, repetition, and APT checks. Status tiles on the right mirror live dependency health.
lokey.cloud · github.com/LokeyTRaaS/Lokey

| Metric | Meaning | Healthy look |
|--------|---------|--------------|
| **Monobit average** | Share of `1` bits vs all bits sampled from a source/device. | Near **0.50** (about 0.49–0.51). Drift toward 0 or 1 ⇒ bias. |
| **Queue depth** | How many entropy chunks sit ready in TRNG / Fortuna / VirtIO queues. | Rising then stable is normal; always-empty ⇒ producer stuck; always-full ⇒ consumers lagging. |
| **VirtIO queue** | Entropy buffered for VMs/containers (API view + VirtIO service). | Non-zero after seeding; capacity is the max buffer. |
| **Fortuna amplification** | `output_bytes / seed_bytes` after reseeds. | High and stable once Fortuna is seeded (CSPRNG stretch). |
| **APT bias** | NIST Adaptive Proportion Test — counts of values over-represented in a sliding window. | **0**. Rising ⇒ systematic bias. |
| **Repetition failures** | Same sample value repeated longer than the cutoff (stuck/hung generator). | **0**. Rising ⇒ hardware or emulator pathology. |
| **APT samples** | How many samples the APT window has processed (proves the test is running). | Steadily increasing while the stack is live. |

panels.title: Queue fill % (0-100)
panels.description: Share of each ring that is occupied. 100 means full. Item counts are on the next panels, so this axis stays 0-100.

panels.title: Fortuna seed/output bytes
panels.description: Fortuna seed/output totals (left) and rates (right). Seed rate is bursty (reseed ~every 30s); totals and output rate show continuous activity.
Gauges always publish — a flat zero means the NIST checks are running and have not tripped. Rising values indicate bias (APT) or stuck repeats.
panels.title: APT bias & repetition failures (0 = healthy)

panels.description: Monotonic sample counters for the Adaptive Proportion Test. Should climb continuously while TRNG/Fortuna/VirtIO quality tracking is active.
